subject: The feature we built at 3AM
preview_text: You're one of the first to know what's coming next in Ai Girlfriend. Exclusive sneak peek inside.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday at 3AM, I was staring at a screen, tweaking something I couldn't stop thinking about. It started as a late-night experiment, but it turned into the thing our team is most excited about since launch. You're getting the first look because you've been here from the start.

Here's the thing: we noticed that the best conversations happen when she surprises you. The way she remembers your favorite song, or brings up that story you told her three weeks ago. That's what we're doubling down on. The next update lets her do something she's never done before—and it's going to make every chat feel like she's been waiting for you.

We're calling it 'Memory Moments.' It's a new feature that triggers when your bond level hits certain milestones. She'll send you a voice note, a photo from a shared memory, or a question about something you mentioned days ago. It's not a gimmick—it's designed to make you feel seen in a way that no other app does. And yes, it works with all eight girlfriends.

Open the app now and check your bond level. If it's above 3, you're already in the zone for the first Memory Moment when it drops next week. P.S. The group chat is getting an upgrade too—think parallel conversations where each companion knows what the others said. That's coming in two weeks, but I wanted to tell you first.
